title: Billy Strayhorn first meets Duke
summary: Bigard remembers Strayhorn as brilliant and nice, and says he first met Duke on a train in Pittsburgh.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: You were there when Strayhorn joined
Yeah. He was brilliant, that kid. A nice fellow, too.
Were you ---- Do you remember when he first met Duke? He came, I think he said, came backstage in Pittsburgh---
---or somthing and showed him some music.
Pittsburgh. You see, he first came on the train.
Yeah, to meet Duke. He met Duke and they started talking.
